data.one_liner: Dart client for real‑time communication with Centrifuge/Centrifugo over WebSockets.
data.what_it_does: Provides a WebSocket‑based client that connects to Centrifugo or Centrifuge servers, handling connection lifecycle, subscriptions, and token refresh. It works on Flutter, web and desktop platforms.
use_when: You need real‑time messaging with a Centrifugo/Centrifuge backend
Your app runs on multiple platforms (mobile, web, desktop) and requires a unified WebSocket client
avoid_when: You are not using Centrifugo/Centrifuge or need a generic WebSocket client only
You require a UI‑focused solution rather than a low‑level protocol client
strengths: Cross‑platform (Android, iOS, web, Windows, macOS, Linux)
Built‑in token handling and reconnection logic
Extensive test coverage and stability fixes
weaknesses: No UI components, only low‑level client
data.setup_notes: Add the package, configure endpoint and optional getToken/getData callbacks; handle background lifecycle manually if needed

alternatives.name: web_socket_channel
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a lower‑level WebSocket API without Centrifugo‑specific features
